summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run (per instructions), so tests and mypy are unverified. No commits were made.
